messages.content: I'm planning a series of long weekend getaways for the upcoming year and I need to know when they'll occur in my country. Could you fetch me the list of long weekends for Canada in the year 2023? I'd like to integrate this information into my holiday planning app.

function.name: SimpleQuestion_ask
function.description: Presents a simple question based on the provided context and expects an answer from a predefined set of options. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

question.description: The question posed to the user.

answer.description: The selected answer to the question, which must be one of the provided options.

message.content:
I’m sorry, but I don’t have the ability to retrieve real‑time data or browse the web. However, I can give you a quick rundown of the major Canadian public holidays in 2023 that typically create long weekends:

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Typical Long Weekend |
|---------|-------------|----------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 (Sunday) | Jan 1–3 (New Year’s weekend) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB) | Feb 20 (Monday) | Feb 18–20 (Family Day weekend) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 (Friday) | Apr 7–9 (Good Friday & Easter weekend) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 (Monday) | May 20–22 (Victoria Day weekend) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 1–3 (Canada Day weekend) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 (Monday) | Sep 2–4 (Labour Day weekend) |
| Thanksgiving (Canada) | Oct 9 (Monday) | Oct 7–9 (Thanksgiving weekend) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 (Wednesday) | Nov 10–12 (Remembrance weekend) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 (Monday) | Dec 23–25 (Christmas weekend) |
| Boxing Day | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Dec 24–26 (Christmas/Boxing weekend) |

If you need a more detailed calendar—including provincial holidays that might affect your specific region—you could consult the official Government of Canada “Public Holidays” page or use a holiday‑API service such as Calendarific or Timezonedb. Let me know if you’d like help formatting this data for your app!
